set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: Q03.3
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Institutional operator and service owner
Scope: Make pilot readiness a deliberate evidence-backed decision.

Work kind: institutional
Acceptance gate: Q03 (bd-01M4W40M7DJRQJWNCBEPR0AFEN)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Verify every required epic/gate and any EP7/EP8 activated by SITE01 is complete; reconcile the dependency graph against the accepted scope.
2. Bind the release artifact, configuration, support matrix, capacity, identity/access, user/accessibility and recovery evidence; no stale-source receipt or not-run human result counts as passed.
3. Named service owner, curator and operator record go/no-go, accepted limits, support ownership and rollback/recovery plan; a go authorizes only the bounded pilot, not primary-repository source cutover.

Verification: Versioned pilot acceptance manifest and named decision; program remains open on missing decisions or required evidence.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/Q03.3/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

External inputs:
- Named pilot acceptance owners

Source/contracts:
- docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md#5-what-qualification-must-prove
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- SITE01: bd-01M4W40J6HFTNMMMEH40K1KSYM

- Q03.2: bd-01M4W5PCQ52DFGXPX1K4NW9Q1F
- EP9: bd-01M4X8M8Y18BD586KA2AD1BMH9

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: Q03.3: Assemble evidence and record the institutional pilot go or no-go
